title: Training review material
scope: Timestamped supplied transcript; no speech recognition

files.inputs/transcript.txt:
00:00 [P1] Topic: Seed storage. Label each packet with its harvest year.
05:00 [P2] Topic: Sowing. Place one seed in each pot.
10:00 [P3] Topic: Sowing continued. Check the pots after 10 days.
15:00 [P4] Topic: Record keeping. Log the germination date.

phases.prompt:
Turn the supplied transcript into outputs/study-notes.md. Group continued sections with their topic. The JSON result has topics:[{id,paragraphs,timestamp}] with topic IDs storage, sowing, records, check_after_days, and uncertain_paragraphs. Do not silently repair inaudible text.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
